subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: The prescribed root cause fix was NOT implemented. There is no ContentstackProvider component with useState for reactive content, no useEffect subscribing to ContentstackLivePreview.onEntryChange(), and no deep-merge of incoming live preview data. The context is a bare createContext with a static value supplied by ContentstackContext.Provider in [[...slug]].tsx. Without a reactive state mechanism, no downstream consumer (236+ components using useContent) can ever receive live preview updates. Every acceptance criterion — real-time update without reload, all display locations updating, partial updates of only changed content — is unmet because the reactivity mechanism is entirely absent.
issues.suggestedFix: Create or update src/context/contentstackContext.tsx to export a ContentstackProvider component that: (1) holds content via useState(defaultContent); (2) has a useEffect that calls ContentstackLivePreview.init() from '@contentstack/live-preview-utils' and subscribes to onEntryChange, deep-merging incoming data into state via setContent(prev => deepMerge(prev, liveData)); (3) provides { content } as the context value. Replace the bare ContentstackContext.Provider usage in [[...slug]].tsx with <ContentstackProvider defaultContent={content}>.

issues.description: The @contentstack/live-preview-utils dependency is not installed anywhere in the project. No import of this package exists in the codebase. Without the SDK, no Live Preview subscription can be established.
issues.suggestedFix: Add '@contentstack/live-preview-utils' as a dependency in package.json and import ContentstackLivePreview from it in the ContentstackProvider.

issues.description: useContent calls useContext(ContentstackContext) but there is no reactive Provider component in the codebase. The hook will always return the static value passed at render time from [[...slug]].tsx. Even if ContentstackLivePreview events fired, there is no state setter to trigger re-renders of the 236+ consumers. The hook cannot propagate live preview updates as-is.
issues.suggestedFix: Once ContentstackProvider with useState is implemented, useContent will automatically receive reactive updates via useContext. No change needed to useContent itself — but it is blocked on the provider fix above.

issues.description: The page wraps content in <ContentstackContext.Provider value={content}> with a static prop value. This is the direct integration point that should use the prescribed ContentstackProvider component instead. As long as this uses the raw context Provider with a static value, no live preview updates can propagate.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace <ContentstackContext.Provider value={content}> with <ContentstackProvider defaultContent={content}> so that the provider can manage reactive state internally.

issues.description: TypeScript strict compliance violation: the IPageProps interface uses untyped 'any' — footer?: [any] — without an explanatory comment. This violates the strict typing requirement.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace [any] with a properly typed interface, e.g. footer?: [IContentstackFooter], or add an explanatory comment if a type is genuinely unavailable: // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any -- footer schema not yet typed.

issues.description: No vitest unit tests were found for the Live Preview feature. There are no tests mirroring src/context/ for the ContentstackProvider, no tests for onEntryChange callback behavior, and no tests verifying deep-merge of live preview data. The test count has not increased to cover this new feature.
issues.suggestedFix: Add test/unit/context/contentstackContext.test.tsx (or .test.ts) with tests that: (1) verify ContentstackProvider initializes content from defaultContent; (2) verify onEntryChange callback updates content state; (3) verify deep-merge behavior when partial data is received; (4) verify cleanup/unsubscribe on unmount.

issues.description: No deepMerge utility exists anywhere in the codebase. The prescribed fix calls for deep-merging incoming live preview data into existing content state. Without a deep-merge, a simple spread-based merge would only shallow-merge top-level keys, potentially losing nested content that wasn't included in the live preview payload.
issues.suggestedFix: Either install/use an existing deep-merge library (e.g. lodash.merge) or implement a small deepMerge utility in src/utils/ and add unit tests for it. Verify with the codegraph tool that no existing helper provides this functionality before implementing.
